# Welcome to SurgePix

SurgePix

### SurgePix

AI visuals. Edit every layer. Agent-callable.

Check it out on Product Hunt →

Generate Anything. Edit Everything.

Surgepix is an AI design workspace that takes you from idea to finished, ready-to-use visuals—images, posters, presentations, infographics, social and e-commerce assets—and lets you keep editing every result with AI until it's right. [...] Full editing, not one-shot generation. Turn any result into a Project and keep working—edit text, swap images, adjust colors, restructure layouts, resize pages.
 An AI assistant in every Project. No design software to learn—just chat: "make the title blue," "enlarge all fonts," "change the style to tech." It can edit a single element, a whole page, or the entire project.
 A Designer Agent that searches the web. Surgepix searches the internet, reads pages, then generates visuals from what it finds—so your work builds on the latest news, data, and trends, not just training data.
 Inpainting. Mark a region, describe the change, and only that area updates—no regenerating the whole image. [...] Extract Text. Split the text in an image into editable layers, so you can edit copy without re-rendering the artwork.
 Agent Skills. Surgepix works for AI agents too—Claude Code, Cursor, and other frameworks can call Skills like Presentation Creator, Poster Creator, and Background Remover directly via API.
